newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Monday, following price rallies during the day because of the weaker yen late last week, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen lower to 0.2 yen higher than the day's close. Benchmark May was 0.1 yen higher at 146.8 yen.

During the day, all months gained from the opening due to the yen's falls against the dollar, traders said. The Tokyo rubber market's price gains also helped boost buying interest at the Kobe market, they said.
Position adjustment at the spot month, which expires on December 20, will be a market factor this week, they said.
